reason: I'd grab the free tricks, sure, but 99 shekels for something I'm scared I'll mess up in front of my friends? Not this week. And an app from a website, not the App Store, paid by card there, makes me a bit nervous too.
objection: I'm not a magician. If the trick flops in the middle of a party, I'm the one looking stupid, not the app.
would_change_my_mind: A short video of a regular person like me pulling it off at a party, and the free tricks working for me on the first try so I know I won't fail.
